notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Qwen2.5-14B derivative, dense GQA. config.json: model_type qwen2, Qwen2ForCausalLM, hidden_size 5120, num_hidden_layers 48, num_attention_heads 40, num_key_value_heads 8 (gqa_ratio 5), no head_dim key so head_dim = 5120/40 = 128, max_position_embeddings 131,072, rope_scaling null (native 128k, rope_theta 1e6), sliding_window null / use_sliding_window false, torch_dtype bfloat16. 2 (K+V) x 48 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes = 196,608 B/token (192 KiB); at the full 131,072-token window that is 24.0 GiB of KV for one sequence. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card publishes benchmark table; all 6 record rows match 14B row. Card prints no eval config.
